title: Player-aware trigger adapter fixture
flow: validate trigger, session readiness and event ID
validate native primary/secondary pair before wait
wait on the supplied trigger entity and capture activator
revalidate the native pair after wait
confirm activator belongs to the registered pair
acquire the event lock for that activator
return the actual activator only after lock acquisition
safeguards: compile-only local stubs are not a PS3 payload
